findings.evidence: Conclusion is `Function.Injective (_root_.groupCohomology.map (P : Subgroup G).subtype ...)`. The naming convention says the name describes the conclusion, and `map` here is `groupCohomology.map`, whose namespace is dropped outside `groupCohomology`.
findings.fix: Name the object being mapped, e.g. `IsAddPGroup.groupCohomology_map_sylow_injective` and `IsPGroup.groupCohomology_map_subtype_quotientConjugation_sylow_injective`, matching the sibling `IsAddPGroup.groupCohomology`.
findings.issue: `IsAddPGroup.map_sylow_injective` concludes injectivity of `groupCohomology.map P.subtype (𝟙 _) n`, but the name never mentions cohomology. In the Mathlib namespace `IsAddPGroup`, `hA.map_sylow_injective` reads as a statement about the additive group `A` itself. Same issue: `IsPGroup.map_subtype_quotientConjugation_sylow_injective` (Restriction.lean:401).

findings.evidence: Corestriction.lean diff: `theorem map_subtype_injective_of_coprime_index_natCard ... (hcop : Nat.Coprime S.index (Nat.card A))`; Restriction.lean:297: `theorem map_subtype_quotientConjugation_injective_of_coprime_index ... (hcop : Nat.Coprime H.index (Nat.card N))`.
findings.fix: Rename the Restriction lemma to `map_subtype_quotientConjugation_injective_of_coprime_index_natCard`. Alternatively, drop `_natCard` in Corestriction to follow the existing Gaschutz convention (`Subgroup.IsLocalComplement.exists_isComplement'_of_coprime_index`, Gaschutz.lean:144). Either way, use one scheme throughout.
findings.issue: The PR names its Nat.card-coprime variants two ways: `TauCeti.groupCohomology.map_subtype_injective_of_coprime_index_natCard` (Corestriction) next to `_exponent`, but `Subgroup.map_subtype_quotientConjugation_injective_of_coprime_index` (Restriction) next to `_exponent`. Both are paired with exponent variants, so the suffixes should match.

summary: Two cohomology injectivity lemmas in Mathlib's p-group namespaces leave `groupCohomology` out of their names, and the Nat.card-coprime variants added in this PR are named two different ways.
